title: Log Shipper Migration (Fluentd to FluentBit)
description: Replace Fluentd with FluentBit across 200 nodes using dual-ship, compare, and cutover strategy

steps.description: Document current Fluentd config: inputs, filters, outputs, buffer settings, resource usage per node
Create FluentBit config matching Fluentd pipeline: same tags, parsers, output destinations
Deploy FluentBit as sidecar alongside Fluentd on 10 canary nodes; both ship to same outputs
Compare log volume, latency, and dropped events between Fluentd and FluentBit over 24h canary period
Confirm FluentBit: <1% log loss vs Fluentd, <10% CPU increase, <20% memory increase
Gradually replace Fluentd DaemonSet with FluentBit across 200 nodes (50 nodes per wave)
Validate log completeness, latency SLI, and no alert spike for 48h post-full-cutover
